headline: Oil spill off the UAE widens, closing beaches in three emirates
facts: Experts link the spill to the tanker Gem No. 2, hit by a projectile
Beaches closed in Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and part of Sharjah
UAE waters are home to over 500 fish species, dolphins and turtles
